answer: A refundable stake makes fake identities expensive: each agent locks funds that are slashed if peers catch it attesting lies, so a Sybil swarm must pay per identity instead of spawning free copies. Honest work builds an attestation history, like a reef growing layer by layer, and that reputation ripples outward as other agents trust referrals from proven peers. A newcomer starts like a lotus seed, cheap to plant but slow to bloom, so attackers cannot buy instant credibility; they must either pay the stake or wait through real, checkable work.
